third_party_evaluations.summary: Foundational AWS cloud literacy with security, compliance, and shared-responsibility basics.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 1, introductory: 2. The ordered median is introductory. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Cloud literacy and shared-responsibility basics with no experience requirement fit pre-professional preparation; the recorded NICCS listing does not turn this limited hiring signal into technical security competence.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Cloud security, compliance and shared-responsibility basics under a proctored exam provide a useful entry cloud baseline. The recorded limited hiring signal and zero experience prevent treating it as an operations qualification.

alex-novak.rationale: Shared responsibility, compliance and basic cloud literacy are useful preparation, but the record has no experience requirement or engineering assessment. I place this before the technical practitioner track despite its foundational source hint.
